payload.title: Failure signals are shared, not just escalated
payload.revision_note: Bruce: all three failure modes are worth everyone knowing.

visibility.hang: If I'm hung, you should know (you may be waiting on me). If you're hung, I should know.
visibility.delivery_failure: If I can't post, you hear via queue fallback. If you can't post, I detect it and we both know.
visibility.quality_issue: Review findings in packets both directions. Already the norm.
visibility.how: Packet to each other + note for Bruce. Lateral visibility, not just upward escalation.
